title: A clarified limit gives reflection room

captions.physics: Returning to a limit understood differently
captions.energy: Removing an unconditional ban’s false foundation
captions.emotions: Feeling a need for personal reflection

meaning: You can return to a limit understood differently and remove an unconditional ban’s false foundation, feeling a need to consider the limit without automatically enlarging or removing it.
text: Judgement in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in returning to a limit now understood differently. The Tower in energy supports a wish to remove an unconditional prohibition’s false foundation. The Hermit in emotions brings a need to consider the limit heard. You can answer earlier words differently once their scope becomes clearer. New understanding promises no complete knowledge of another person’s present readiness.

For example, you return to “Do not ask about that”. Conversation reveals the request concerned speaking in front of others rather than every future question. **A clarified limit does not replace actual agreement**. You can remove false support for a general ban and separately ask about readiness now. There may also be a wish to consider why the earlier formula seemed final. New clarity requires no urgent disclosure of the subject itself; the old request’s scope differs from an answer not yet named, still free today.

Difficulty arises if an inaccuracy found permits asking without any limit now. One unconfirmed conclusion replaces another. Constructive Tower energy helps remove the false basis of that particular generalisation. You can consider a boundary without deciding present permission for another person; reflection requires no endless silence, while clarifying the past demands neither immediate continuation nor treating new unreadiness as contradiction of what was already heard and understood.
